## Research change

- What major research, data, or documentation change does this pull request make?
- Why is it needed?

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Input workbook and SHA-256 hash recorded
- [ ] Prompt/model configuration recorded
- [ ] Notebook contains outputs
- [ ] Raw logs/checkpoints retained when applicable
- [ ] Completion and integrity audits pass
- [ ] No API keys or private credentials included

## Interpretation

- [ ] Results are labeled current, historical, provisional, or partial
- [ ] Codebook and gold-label version stated
- [ ] Limitations updated if conclusions changed
- [ ] Changelog updated only for a major research change
